_README: Consumed by .claude/hooks/post-edit-check.js (PostToolUse). Each entry maps a changed-file regex to a verification command run from `cwd`. The FIRST command-bearing match wins (only one command runs per edit), so order specific patterns before broad ones AND chain multiple checks into one command with '&&'. Note-only entries (no `command`) just print a reminder and let scanning continue.

checks.command: dotnet build UgcIntelligence.slnx -v q --nologo && dotnet test tests/Architecture --nologo -v q
checks.label: control plane builds + architecture suite green

checks.command: uv run --with ruff ruff check src/IntelligencePlane tests/architecture && uv run --with pytest pytest tests/architecture
checks.label: intelligence plane lints + tests green

checks.command: dotnet test tests/Architecture --nologo -v q --filter FullyQualifiedName~ProvenanceParityTests && uv run --with pytest pytest tests/architecture -k parity
checks.label: C#/Python provenance parity holds

checks.command: npm --prefix src/Frontend run typecheck && npm --prefix src/Frontend test
checks.label: frontend typechecks + honesty suite green
UGC contract schemas parse (frozen doc set — edits here are suspect)
